topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session by connecting it to earlier practicals and outlining the day's learning outcomes on cancer genetics.

topics.label: Tumor Virology, Proto-Oncogenes, and Transformation Assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the historical study of tumor viruses led to the discovery of cellular proto-oncogenes and the experimental assays used to measure cellular transformation.

topics.label: Oncogenes, Tumor Suppressor Genes, and Cell Cycle Control
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the functional classifications of oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes and illustrate their mechanisms through cell cycle regulation and mutation dosage effects.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Types of Genetic Instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how specific failures in DNA repair pathways, replication fidelity, and chromosome segregation during mitosis cause sequence and chromosomal instability.

topics.label: Multistep Progression and Hereditary Cancer Predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how sequential somatic mutations and inherited genetic predispositions drive and accelerate tumor progression and evolution.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Recommended Reading
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session, suggests further reading, and previews the next lecture on cancer hallmarks.
